name: dashi-motion native production skills
description: 10 attributed production rules distilled from dashi-motion. The original AE/Rive/Cavalry references are preserved for review; Cupric applies the principles through its own deterministic renderer.
license: No upstream license declared — reference-only attribution; see resources/dashi-motion/UPSTREAM-NOTICE.md

items.name: Route by delivery software
items.description: Identify whether the task is an AE project, Rive state machine, Cavalry node scene, or Cupric native scene before choosing techniques. Do not silently replace an editable native deliverable with a flattened video.

data.instruction: Identify whether the task is an AE project, Rive state machine, Cavalry node scene, or Cupric native scene before choosing techniques. Do not silently replace an editable native deliverable with a flattened video.

items.name: Break references into observable beats
items.description: Measure duration, frame rate, aspect ratio, shot boundaries, direction, spacing, counts, proportions, holds, speed peaks, transitions and end states before styling. Compare matching timestamps, not arbitrary frame numbers.

data.instruction: Measure duration, frame rate, aspect ratio, shot boundaries, direction, spacing, counts, proportions, holds, speed peaks, transitions and end states before styling. Compare matching timestamps, not arbitrary frame numbers.

items.name: Use native editable objects
items.description: Keep text, paths, shapes, controls, keyframes, state machines and repeated relationships editable. A large script or flattened screenshot is not equivalent to user-facing editability.

data.instruction: Keep text, paths, shapes, controls, keyframes, state machines and repeated relationships editable. A large script or flattened screenshot is not equivalent to user-facing editability.

items.name: Share repeated motion controls
items.description: Use one master progress, duplicator, array, state value or timeline controller for repeated motion; keep genuinely independent actions independent. Do not expand every copy into opaque keyframes.

data.instruction: Use one master progress, duplicator, array, state value or timeline controller for repeated motion; keep genuinely independent actions independent. Do not expand every copy into opaque keyframes.

items.name: Fix motion before polish
items.description: When a result feels wrong, check direction, pivot, layer distance, count, spacing, expansion, settle and speed curve before adding grain, shadow or extra effects.

data.instruction: When a result feels wrong, check direction, pivot, layer distance, count, spacing, expansion, settle and speed curve before adding grain, shadow or extra effects.

items.name: Discover properties before writing
items.description: Enumerate effect properties, match names, ports, renderers, inputs and current values before changing them. Do not trust numeric indexes, old coordinates, or a similarly named property.

data.instruction: Enumerate effect properties, match names, ports, renderers, inputs and current values before changing them. Do not trust numeric indexes, old coordinates, or a similarly named property.

items.name: Separate open/save from render
items.description: Open the confirmed project, verify the correct file and visible frame, save it, then render in a separate step. Do not treat a generated script or queued job as proof of a rendered result.

data.instruction: Open the confirmed project, verify the correct file and visible frame, save it, then render in a separate step. Do not treat a generated script or queued job as proof of a rendered result.

items.name: Review decoded output
items.description: Decode the actual output, check dimensions, frame count, timestamps, audio and key action frames, then compare the motion at matching times. A thumbnail or metadata-only check is insufficient.

data.instruction: Decode the actual output, check dimensions, frame count, timestamps, audio and key action frames, then compare the motion at matching times. A thumbnail or metadata-only check is insufficient.

items.name: State evidence honestly
items.description: Distinguish file written, app opened, project saved, native-rendered, decoded and compared. Record unconfirmed causes as unconfirmed instead of claiming a professional result from a script exit code.

data.instruction: Distinguish file written, app opened, project saved, native-rendered, decoded and compared. Record unconfirmed causes as unconfirmed instead of claiming a professional result from a script exit code.

items.name: Continue from the accepted baseline
items.description: When adding a new segment, find the newest accepted project, preserve accepted work, confirm its end frame and current controls, and change only the requested range before extending the scene.

data.instruction: When adding a new segment, find the newest accepted project, preserve accepted work, confirm its end frame and current controls, and change only the requested range before extending the scene.
